package ratelimit // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/ratelimit"

type Limiter struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func New(perHour float64, burst int) *Limiter

func NewBucket(perHour float64, burst, capacity int, clock func() time.Time) *Limiter

func (l *Limiter) Allow(key string) (ok bool, retryAfter time.Duration)

func (l *Limiter) Buckets() int

func (l *Limiter) Enabled() bool

func (l *Limiter) Peek(key string) (limited bool, retryAfter time.Duration)

type Window struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func NewWindow(config WindowConfig) *Window

func (w *Window) Allow(key string) (bool, time.Duration)

func (w *Window) Keys() int

func (w *Window) Peek(key string) (limited bool, retryAfter time.Duration)

func (w *Window) Refund(key string)

type WindowConfig struct {
	Attempts int
	Interval time.Duration
	Capacity int

	RejectNew bool
	Clock     func() time.Time
}
